# Beta122 — Persistent trends and clearer card navigation

- Preserve room-average history when sensors return at different times after
  a Home Assistant restart. Each exact contributor set retains separate,
  bounded history; a temporary three-to-two-to-three-sensor transition no
  longer replaces the original series. Missing periods remain visible gaps.
- Open the same interactive 6-hour, 24-hour, 7-day and All history window for
  individual sensor readings and contributing sensors. Use **Open entity**
  inside the window to open the native Home Assistant entity.
- Read existing entity history from Home Assistant. Keep actual values, units,
  missing intervals, selected periods and cursor position; loading, unavailable
  current values and history errors have clear states. No device command is
  sent when opening or navigating a chart.
- Put the physical device-page icon before its entity's friendly name and
  remove the trailing icon. Add a leading HEM device-page button before each
  integration controller name. Friendly names continue to open their entities.
- Show only the icon and On/Off state on device announcement buttons, retaining
  descriptive tooltips and accessible labels.
- Use expanded room tiles for information not already in the folded overview.
  Keep additional measurements, warning explanations and calibration details
  without repeating the same current readings.

Stored average histories migrate automatically. Samples already overwritten
by an older version cannot be recovered by this update. Individual sensor
history depends on Home Assistant retaining that entity's recordings.

Update through HACS, restart Home Assistant and refresh the dashboard to load
the updated card. No settings reset is required.
